summary: Oregon Department of Forestry 40-foot L-4 tower on Baber Mountain, Lincoln County: built 1940, removed 1969 or 1970; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 40-foot pole L-4 tower with 14 by 14 cabin; AWS cabin added 1942
facts.status_note: Removed in 1969 or 1970; sources disagree on the year and on whether it was dismantled or destroyed. No source describes the site today.

staffing.status: patrolman posted 1940-1941; volunteers manned it in December 1941; college couple took over the post in 1942

events.note: 10-acre site bought for the lookout (Lincoln County fire annual report, via Oregon lookouts page)
40-foot tower with 14 by 14 cabin on top; CCC crews did road and tower; register calls it a pole L-4 tower

AWS cabin added (register and firelookout.com); annual report says an 18 by 20 ground cabin was built; sources disagree
Mr. and Mrs. Keith Bannister took over the post on May 26

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says removed in 1970, firelookout.com says destroyed in 1970, and the Oregon lookouts page says dismantled in 1969. The story reports the disagreement and does not choose one date.

The 1940 annual report puts a 14 by 14 cabin on top of the tower; the June 1942 inspection describes a 14 by 14 Aladdin cabin on a 40-foot tower; the 1942 annual report says an 18 by 20 ground cabin was built that year. The story says the sources disagree.

notes_for_editor: The timeline rests mostly on one compiled page (oregonlookouts.weebly.com) that quotes 1930s-1960s Lincoln County fire annual reports and Corvallis newspapers. The register and firelookout.com repeat the 1940 and 1942 details and the removal year, so they are not independent confirmation. Brief record checked: height 12.2 m matches the register's 40 ft; elevation and registration date match; no corrections. Access left out of facts because no source describes access to the site today. Two WebSearch calls and four distinct page reads used. The 'Baker' and 'Babor' spellings in the old records were not used in the story text.
